overclaims: Vibe coding customers are now realizing that the tools are unreliable and unsuited to complex real-world apps.
Barclays data reported by TechCrunch shows traffic to Lovable and Vercel's v0 fell after summer 2025 peaks, with Lovable down 40% by September.
So there was a usage pullback at some platforms.
Shows a real usage pullback at major platforms in the target period.
A major vibe-coding platform reported fast growth in paid usage during the target period.
checks.note: The proposition omits maintainability and broadens Marcus's defined scope of amateurs building products; that scope and the familiar-task qualification are absent throughout. Evidence dates traffic peaks only to earlier in 2025, not summer. Traffic and annualized revenue are proxies, not direct measurements of usage or paid usage. Citation excerpts, metadata, relations and the agreed outcome match.
